name: settings-screen
title: Settings screen
description: A settings page: labelled rows with supporting text and trailing controls, in a filled card. Reach for it when settings are rows of label plus control.

name: auth-form
title: Sign-in form
description: A sign-in card: labelled email field with helper text, password input, submit action. Reach for it when sign-in is one card, not a page.

name: empty-search
title: Empty search state
description: A no-results state: titled empty state with a clear-search action. Reach for it when a search or filter yields nothing.

name: empty-states
title: Empty states
description: The three zero-data placements: full page, card section and list row, each with a recovery action. Reach for it when an empty view needs its placement variant, not a new component.

name: billing
title: Billing page
description: A billing page: Growth-plan slot with status pill plus a display-only invoice ledger. Reach for it when billing is plan display plus invoice history, never payment actions.

name: dashboard
title: Dashboard page
description: A dashboard page: stat cards, activity feed and an ops queue table. Reach for it when the page is figures plus feed plus queue.

name: signup
title: Sign-up page
description: A sign-up page: name, email and password fields in a filled card with a submit action. Reach for it when sign-up is one card, not a flow.

name: otp
title: One-time code
description: A one-time code card: six boxed inputs with a verify action that enables at full length. Reach for it for email/SMS code verification.

name: invite
title: Invite accept
description: A workspace invite accept flow: who invited you, which workspace and role, accept and decline. Reach for it when invites arrive out of band.

name: settings
title: Settings page
description: A full settings page: profile, notification and preference preset sections in a sidebar layout. Reach for it when settings need sections, not rows.

name: contacts
title: Contacts directory
description: A searchable contacts directory: inline search over grouped rows with an empty state. Reach for it when people are rows to find and pick.

name: list-detail
title: List-detail queue
description: A searchable queue beside its detail pane: filter rows, pick one to read the thread. Reach for it when work is a list of things each with its own detail.
